title: Leto: Utility-Centric Agent Memory
title_zh: Leto：以效用为中心的智能体记忆
abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents rely on external memory to retain and reuse information across interactions. Existing memory systems treat memory as a record of the past and evaluate it by fidelity to the conversation. However, the value of memory lies in whether it improves the agent's response. A memory system decides what to memorize and what to serve before that response exists, and fidelity checks neither decision against it. Faithful memory can therefore fail to improve the response. We instead view memory as a prediction problem and present \textbf{\emph{\leto{}}}, a memory system for LLM agents that focuses on the utility of memory to the future rather than on its fidelity to the past. Because future requests are unknown, \emph{\leto{}} preserves access to conversation details through memory indexing, allowing information to remain available through its sources. When a request arrives, memory replay draws on this index to anticipate and supply the context the agent needs beyond what the request explicitly states. The utility of the served context remains uncertain until the response is generated, motivating a utility loop that uses response outcomes to refine future memory selection. We evaluate our system against six memory systems on five benchmarks across three scenarios. In personalization, it outperforms the strongest compared memory system by 16.3 percentage points in accuracy on PrefEval and by 3.1 points in task completion on PERMA. For long-horizon tasks, it achieves the best overall performance on MemoryArena averaged over five environments with a gain that increases with the chain depth. In long-context understanding, it is on par with retrieval over the raw history while serving fewer context tokens.
abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体依赖外部记忆，在多轮交互中保留并复用信息。现有系统通常以记忆是否忠实于历史对话为评价标准，但忠实记录并不一定能改善后续回答。Leto 将记忆视为一个预测问题：关键不在于能否还原过去，而在于能否为未来的请求提供有用信息。由于未来请求未知，Leto 通过记忆索引（memory indexing）保留回溯原始对话细节的途径；收到请求后，通过记忆回放（memory replay）预测并补充请求未明确指出、但智能体可能需要的上下文；生成回答后，再通过效用闭环（utility loop）利用回答结果改进后续的记忆选择。论文在三类场景的五个基准上与六种记忆系统进行比较。在个性化场景中，Leto 相比最强对照系统在 PrefEval 上的准确率提高 16.3 个百分点，在 PERMA 上的任务完成率提高 3.1 个百分点。在长程任务中，Leto 在 MemoryArena 的五个环境中平均表现最佳，且优势随任务链深度增加而扩大。在长上下文理解中，Leto 以更少的上下文 token 达到与直接检索原始对话历史相当的表现。
key_points_zh: 忠实复述历史不等于选对上下文：Leto 以记忆能否改善后续回答为目标。
记忆索引保留原始细节的访问路径，记忆回放补足请求未明说的上下文，效用闭环用回答结果改进后续选择。
个性化方面，相比最强对照系统，PrefEval 准确率提高 16.3 个百分点，PERMA 任务完成率提高 3.1 个百分点。
MemoryArena 五个环境的平均表现最佳，任务链越深，优势越大。
长上下文理解中，送入更少的上下文 token，表现仍与直接检索原始对话历史相当。

agent-memory.reason: 核心贡献是面向未来响应效用的外部记忆：索引保留对历史细节的访问，回放补充请求未明示的上下文，并用响应结果调整后续记忆选择。摘要给出了量化基线对比，但未报告各组件的消融结果或具体的上下文令牌节省幅度。
